name: Switch blank, dashboard
description: Blanking plug for an unequipped switch location in the dashboard. Trim part with flat faces and clips, measurable with calipers, retained as the pilot for the simple geometric category of phase 2.

classification.intended_use: Close an empty dashboard location, with no electrical or structural function

provenance.record_license: All rights reserved (see LICENSE) for the record, geometry not yet produced

sources.title: Rennlist - declared size of a 993 dashboard panel opening (window switch measured)
sources.notes: SRC-RENNLIST-993-DASHBOARD-LIGHTING-DIMENSIONS, level C, declared. A 1996 owner gives about 19 x 31 mm for the passage under the covering and about 17 x 28 mm for the faceplate opening of a switch housing; no instrument, datum or repeat. The page is blocked to automated re-reading. The concept F0 and the fit-test kit use the 19 x 31 mm figure. Transcribed in MEAS-DECLARED-993-INT-SWITCH-BLANK-0001-RL-1202129.

sources.title: Rennlist - declared console switch opening and switch blank sizes, 993
sources.notes: SRC-RENNLIST-993-CONSOLE-SWITCH-HOLE-DIMENSIONS, level C, declared. A 1997 owner gives about 0.67 x 1.10 in (17.0 x 27.9 mm) for the console switch opening and about 0.637 x 1.077 in (16.2 x 27.4 mm) for the blank; no instrument, method, tolerance or repeat. The page is blocked to automated re-reading. Transcribed in MEAS-DECLARED-993-INT-SWITCH-BLANK-0001-RL-750484.

sources.title: partworks - OEM 993 Schalterblende listing, reference 993.613.523.00
sources.notes: SRC-PARTWORKS-993-SWITCH-BLANK-OEM, level B. Retailer listing of an OEM Schalterblende under 9936135230001C / 993.613.523.00, fitment 993 1994-1998, in a switch panel and center console context; no dimension, no PET plate or position. Candidate identity only: the number is not entered in porsche_part_numbers.

titanium.galvanic_isolation: not applicable, polymer interior trim part

known_limits: No measurement made: all dimensions are absent, not estimated.

Porsche part number unsourced: no repository source gives it with a PET plate and position. Candidate 993 613 523 00 (SRC-PARTWORKS-993-SWITCH-BLANK-OEM, retailer listing, level B, switch panel and center console context) stays out of porsche_part_numbers until a PET plate confirms it for this location.

Declared opening contradiction, unresolved (two level-C forum posts, no instrument): the concept F0 and the fit-test kit use 19 x 31 mm, which SRC-RENNLIST-993-DASHBOARD-LIGHTING-DIMENSIONS gives for the passage under the covering; the same source gives about 17 x 28 mm for the faceplate opening of a switch housing, and SRC-RENNLIST-993-CONSOLE-SWITCH-HOLE-DIMENSIONS gives 17.0 x 27.9 mm for the console opening and 16.2 x 27.4 mm for the blank. All three kit inserts (18.6 x 30.6 to 19.4 x 31.4 mm) are larger than a 17.0 x 27.9 mm opening. Transcribed in the two MEAS-DECLARED-993-INT-SWITCH-BLANK-0001 records; see decision 0013.

Location not established: this record says dashboard, the console source concerns the center console, and the lighting source a window switch measured to estimate a lamp opening above the ignition lock.
